framework.role: the writing engine popper generates conjectures with; cited and pinned, not read at run time

testbed.seed_lines_note: line numbers are at the pin; after a diff, the Critic finds both calls by pattern
testbed.hardware: one NVIDIA GPU; the source is tested on H100

train.digest: per-file Git LFS oid at data.revision

probe.role: the source's pinned val shard; every loop verdict is read from it

holdout.role: sealed; at most one comparison, at RETURN if the base changed

harness.patch: line 43: VAL_SHARD = MAX_SHARD - 1  # popper holdout shard (shard_06541)
harness.cache: HOME=<holdout-home>; <holdout-home>/.cache/autoresearch holds the same tokenizer and train shards, shard_06541, and not shard_06542
harness.uv: UV_CACHE_DIR set to the Steward's normal uv cache

never: a result of its own pending conjecture before the verdict
conjecturer.writes: a pick at the hinge, a claim and a prediction; never diff bytes except under verbatim

engine.lexicon: train.py constants at source.commit; each ladder is the Steward's, in ascending order, and holds the pinned value
engine.offered: every (knob, n) with n != 0 and 0 <= index + n < |ladder| at the base, minus moves whose diff bytes equal a refuted diff; knobs in this order, n ascending
engine.bits: log2(|offered|), rounded to 3 decimals, for seed conjecturer; 0 for seed root; null for verbatim
engine.seed_root: index = int(hex(sha256(r || "engine"))[0:8], 16) mod |offered|, r = trace root just before the conjecture
engine.comment_column: kept; at least one space before #

HEAD_DIM.text: HEAD_DIM = 128          # target head dimension for attention

WINDOW_PATTERN.text: WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSL" # sliding window pattern: L=full, S=half context

EMBEDDING_LR.text: EMBEDDING_LR = 0.6      # learning rate for token embeddings (Adam)

MATRIX_LR.text: MATRIX_LR = 0.04        # learning rate for matrix parameters (Muon)

SCALAR_LR.text: SCALAR_LR = 0.5         # learning rate for per-layer scalars (Adam)

WEIGHT_DECAY.text: WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.2      # cautious weight decay for Muon

WARMUP_RATIO.text: WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0      # fraction of time budget for LR warmup

WARMDOWN_RATIO.text: WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.5    # fraction of time budget for LR warmdown

FINAL_LR_FRAC.text: FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.0     # final LR as fraction of initial

DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE.text: DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 128  # per-device batch size (reduce if OOM)

critic.seed: seed_i = int(hex(sha256(root || "seed/" || i))[0:8], 16), i = 1..3, root = trace root just after the event that registers the arm

test.improves: corroborated iff max(h) < min(b) and mean(h) - mean(b) <= -delta; refute at the first h_i >= min(b)
test.simplifies: corroborated iff the diff deletes more lines than it adds and mean(h) - mean(b) <= delta, where delta is delta_min at registration

critic.crash: inconclusive; a missing or non-finite val_bpb is a crash
